full.text:
<<ON PRESSING APPLES FOR CIDER THIS SEASON>>  
PRESSING APPLES FOR CIDER IS A FUN AND FUNNY WAY TO MAKE CIDER IN THE NEIGHBORHOOD. EVERY YEAR, THE NEIGHBORHOOD GATHERS TO PRESS APPLES FOR CIDER. IT'S A GREAT WAY TO CONNECT WITH OTHERS AND MAKE A GOOD TIME. THE PROCESS IS EASY AND FUN. YOU NEED A GOOD SET OF APPLES, A PRESS, AND A GOOD TIME TO PRESS. THE RESULT IS A TASTY CIDER THAT CAN BE DRUNK OR SAVED FOR A FESTIVE EVENT. IT'S A GREAT WAY TO SHOW OFF THE NEIGHBORHOOD'S LOVE FOR APPLES AND CIDER. LET'S KEEP THE CIDER FLOWING!  

[WOOD TYPE] IS USED TO MAKE THE PRESS, [STREET NAME] IS THE LOCATION OF THE NEIGHBORHOOD EVENT, [MAP SHEET] SHOWS THE CIDER PRESSING AREA, AND [JAR LABEL] IS USED TO IDENTIFY THE CIDER. LET'S KEEP THE CIDER FLOWING!
